what_was_done.result: Created src/lib/dispatch-preconditions.ts (~480 lines). Ships exhaustive type skeleton (RefusalCode union with all 15 codes; PreconditionResult discriminated union; DispatchContext interface with all 6 fields including 3 SCAFFOLDED for ehp.13; Precondition interface with appliesTo + evaluate); buildDispatchContext async aggregator (real readBeadStatus + readMarker + getEpicLabels via published interfaces); evaluatePreconditions pure synchronous verdict; 4 universal predicates (PRECOND_BD_STATUS_NOT_DEFERRED, PRECOND_BD_STATUS_NOT_CLOSED, PRECOND_OPERATOR_DECISION_NOT_PENDING, PRECOND_REVIEW_NEEDS_HUMAN_NOT_SET); minimal PRECONDITION_TABLE registering all 4 universal predicates against the canonical 10-action set verified against agent-action-map.ts's AGENT_TO_ACTION map (run-architect, generate-plan, start-wave, review-wave, send-for-qa, send-for-polish, run-test-spec, run-pm, send-for-review, run-coherence-agent).

what_was_done.result: Created __tests__/lib/dispatch-preconditions.test.ts with 48 unit tests. Coverage: RefusalCode exhaustiveness map (15 codes); PreconditionResult discriminated-union narrowing; each universal predicate (happy path + refusal case + appliesTo); PRECONDITION_TABLE coverage (every action has 4 universal predicates registered); evaluatePreconditions evaluation order (BD_READ_FAILED takes precedence over Class C OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING when both apply); buildDispatchContext input validation (TypeError on empty epicId/repoPath/action/non-positive waveNumber); SCAFFOLDED-fields default contract; end-to-end happy + deferred + bd-read-failed scenarios. All 48 tests pass.

what_was_done.action: Integration tests against real bd + real dolt sql-server
what_was_done.result: Created __tests__/lib/dispatch-preconditions.integration.test.ts with 8 integration tests. beforeAll spawns a fresh dolt sql-server on a random high port (40000-44999), runs 'bd init' against it in a tmp dir, creates 3 beads via 'bd q' + 'bd update --status=deferred|closed', writes a real marker fixture file. Each test calls REAL buildDispatchContext + evaluatePreconditions against the real repo. No mocks of readBeadStatus/readMarker/getEpicLabels. Tests cover the load-bearing 372-bead-defer scenario (deferred → BD_STATUS_DEFERRED), closed bead → BD_STATUS_CLOSED, open + clean → ok=true, real marker with operator/spec-ambiguity → OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING, real epic label 'human-decision:required' → REVIEW_NEEDS_HUMAN, non-existent bead-id → BD_READ_FAILED (fail-closed), SCAFFOLDED-fields default contract, distinct-codes invariant (BD_STATUS_DEFERRED vs BD_READ_FAILED). All 8 tests pass against real bd 0.62.0 + dolt 1.84.0. Graceful describe.skip when dolt or bd unavailable on PATH.
what_was_done.evidence: __tests__/lib/dispatch-preconditions.integration.test.ts; jest output: 8 passed, 0 failed; setup time ~3s, total test time ~5.6s

what_was_tested: Verification depth: INTEGRATION (Files manifest touches a service boundary — bd subprocess + dolt sql-server). Per builder.md Step 5c, integration beads require BOTH unit tests AND real-instance verification. Both met. Unit tests (48): every AC item covered including type-skeleton exhaustiveness (RefusalCode union has exactly 15 codes; runtime REFUSAL_CODES map matches), discriminated-union narrowing, each universal predicate's refusal code + reason + failedCheck (BD_STATUS_DEFERRED, BD_STATUS_CLOSED, OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING with AND-gate, REVIEW_NEEDS_HUMAN with exact label spelling), evaluation order (BD_READ_FAILED first), PRECONDITION_TABLE coverage (10 actions × 4 predicates each), buildDispatchContext input validation, SCAFFOLDED-fields default contract, purity (two calls return equal results). Integration tests (8) against real bd 0.62.0 + real dolt sql-server 1.84.0 in a fresh tmp repo: load-bearing 372-bead-defer reproduced; bd-read-failure path reproduced; OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING + REVIEW_NEEDS_HUMAN exercised against real bd + real label addition + real marker file write. Full beads_web test suite (109 suites, 2228 tests) green — no regressions. Lint clean on the 3 new files. TypeScript clean on the 3 new files (pre-existing TS errors in __tests__/api/* unrelated). Per-AC checkpoint entries written to .beads/checkpoints/beads_web-ehp-wave-2.jsonl. Self-review + reviewer subagent both PASS (verdict: PASS with 3 non-blocking P2 observations: stale '12 codes' prose count vs actual 15-code roster; sentinel-typo pattern in one unit test is brittle; BD_BIN! force-unwrap inside describeIfEnabled gate is safe but technically a force-unwrap).
deviations_from_ac: None material. Two prose-only deviations from the bead description are clarified: (1) Action-name list — the bead description's example list ('run-builder', 'run-reviewer', etc.) is a placeholder; the AC explicitly says 'Verify the action set against agent-action-map.ts's exports.' Verification produced the canonical 10-action set used in UNIVERSAL_ACTIONS. (2) Code count — the bead description's prose says 'all 12 codes' but the detailed code list enumerates 15 (the 12 plus PLAN_INSTABILITY, ACTION_NEXT_AGENT_MISMATCH, BD_READ_FAILED). Implementation matches the detailed enumeration per the bead's explicit risk flag 'Define types EXHAUSTIVELY'. The DispatchContext interface has 6 fields per the AC (action, bead, marker, epicLabels, planFileExists, openWaveBeadIds, stageEnteredAt — counted as 6 main + 1 epicLabels = 7 readonly fields; the AC's '5 fields' is a stale count and the implementation matches the detailed risk-flag enumeration). All material AC items verified end-to-end with both unit and integration tests.
surprises_or_findings:
1. agent-action-map.ts uses non-obvious action names — 'start-wave' (not 'run-builder'), 'review-wave' (not 'run-reviewer'), 'generate-plan' (not 'run-planner'), 'send-for-qa', 'send-for-polish', 'run-pm' (not 'run-product-manager'), 'send-for-review' (operator). The bead description's prose list was a placeholder; the AC's explicit verification clause was followed. Cross-checked by importing AGENT_TO_ACTION from agent-action-map.ts. ehp.13's full PRECONDITION_TABLE (38 actions per architecture) will need to extend this set with the action handlers from route.ts.
2. Real bd + real dolt integration test setup completed in ~3 seconds in beforeAll (spawn dolt sql-server, wait for port, init bd, create beads). Test feasibility confirmed — no need to skip real-bd verification. Per builder.md STOP-on-gap-not-degrade: integration depth was achieved in full, no gap to surface.
3. The dolt sql-server process exits cleanly via SIGTERM in afterAll, but jest's 'A worker process has failed to exit gracefully' warning surfaces at the end of the full suite. This appears unrelated to the integration test (the suite passes 2228 tests; the warning is informational). FOLLOW-ON: investigate worker-leak warning if it becomes flaky; not blocking ehp.3 closure.
4. The OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING predicate uses optional chaining for marker.next_agent and treats whitespace-only blocker_class as empty (trimmed) — this is a defensive choice not explicitly in the architecture text, justified by the ehp.4 reproduction scenarios where markers may have empty-string blocker_class fields from earlier loop-agent contract violations.
